title: ConferenceNumber - Data API
description: Holds the telephone number for an external event shown in the Salesforce Today feature in the Salesforce mobile app. This object is available in API version 35.0 and later.

AccessCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccessCode.description: Specifies the access code to enter in order to validate identity and join the call.

ExternalEventId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalEventId.description: The ID of the external event associated with the conference number. This field is a relationship field.

IsLocked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLocked.description: Returns true if the conference number is locked, or false if it’s not. The default value is false.

Label.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Label.description: The description of the conference number.

MayEdit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
MayEdit.notes: Indicates whether the conference number can be edited (true) or not (false).; The default value is false.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the conference call’s organizer.

Number.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Number.description: The phone number used to connect to the conference call.

Vendor.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Vendor.description: The vendor or company associated with the conference number.

special_access_rules: The Salesforce Today app is available in Salesforce for Android and Salesforce for iOS. It’s not available in the Salesforce desktop site. Access to Today is available only if you grant Calendar permission to the Salesforce mobile app.
associated_objects: This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.
